files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: add_to_watchlist
tool_schemas.description: Adds the given stock symbol to the current user’s watchlist and returns the updated watchlist entry (or watchlist) for that symbol. Refuses requests with a missing/blank symbol, an unknown symbol, or a symbol that is already on the user’s watchlist. Refuses if there is no active user session to attach the watchlist change to.

stock.description: the stock symbol to add to the watchlist.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_order
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an existing order by its order ID and returns the resulting order state after the cancellation attempt. Refuses requests with a missing/invalid order_id, an order that does not exist, or an order that belongs to a different user/session. Refuses if the order is not in a cancellable state (for example, already filled, already canceled, or otherwise finalized).

order_id.description: ID of the order to cancel.

tool_schemas.name: filter_stocks_by_price
tool_schemas.description: Filters the provided list of stock symbols to those whose current price falls within the inclusive [min_price, max_price] range and returns the matching symbols (and/or their prices). Refuses requests with an empty stocks list, non-numeric bounds, or a range where min_price is greater than max_price. Refuses if any supplied symbol is unknown or cannot be priced at the time of the request.

stocks.description: List of stock symbols to filter.

tool_schemas.name: fund_account
tool_schemas.description: Credits the current user’s account by the specified amount and returns the updated funding/balance information. Refuses requests with a missing amount, a non-numeric amount, or an amount that is zero or negative. Refuses if there is no active user session or no account available to receive funds.

amount.description: Amount to fund the account with.

tool_schemas.name: get_account_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current user’s account information, such as balances and other account-level state tracked by the session. Refuses if there is no active user session or no account context available. Refuses requests that attempt to supply unsupported parameters.

tool_schemas.name: get_available_stocks
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of available stock symbols for the specified sector. Refuses requests with a missing/blank sector or a sector name that is not recognized by the service. Refuses if sector data is not available for the current session or market context.

sector.description: The sector to retrieve stocks from (e.g., 'Technology').

tool_schemas.name: get_current_time
tool_schemas.description: Returns the service’s current time value. Refuses requests that attempt to supply unsupported parameters. Refuses if the service cannot provide a current time due to unavailable runtime context.

tool_schemas.name: get_order_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns full details for the specified order ID, including its current status and any tracked execution information. Refuses requests with a missing/invalid order_id, an order ID that does not exist, or an order that does not belong to the current user/session. Refuses if there is no active session to authorize access to the order.

tool_schemas.name: get_order_history
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current user’s order-ID history for the session/account. Refuses if there is no active user session or no account context to read history from. Refuses requests that attempt to supply unsupported parameters.

tool_schemas.name: get_stock_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns details for the requested stock symbol (for example, identifiers and current quote fields tracked by the service). Refuses requests with a missing/blank symbol or a symbol that is not recognized. Refuses if stock information is unavailable for that symbol in the current market/session context.

symbol.description: Symbol that uniquely identifies the stock.

tool_schemas.name: get_symbol_by_name
tool_schemas.description: Looks up a tradable instrument by company name and returns the matching stock symbol(s) available in this service. It refuses requests with a missing/blank name, or a name that does not match any known company in the current market data. It may also refuse overly ambiguous queries when it cannot determine a unique match from the provided name.

tool_schemas.name: get_transaction_history
tool_schemas.description: Returns the logged-in user’s cash and/or trading transaction history filtered by the optional start_date and end_date, and returns an empty result when no activity falls in the range. It refuses requests when the user is not logged in, when either date is not in YYYY-MM-DD format, or when start_date is after end_date. It also refuses dates outside the supported historical window when the service cannot retrieve records for that period.

tool_schemas.name: get_watchlist
tool_schemas.description: Returns the logged-in user’s current watchlist of stock symbols tracked in this session. It refuses requests when the user is not logged in or when no watchlist exists for the user’s account context. It also refuses access when the watchlist belongs to a different user/session.

tool_schemas.name: make_transaction
tool_schemas.description: Creates a cash transaction (deposit or withdrawal) against the specified account and returns the recorded transaction and updated balance. It refuses requests when the user is not logged in, when account_id does not exist or is not owned by the logged-in user, when xact_type is not one of the supported values, or when amount is not a positive number. It also refuses withdrawals that would overdraw the account or transactions against an account that is not in an active/eligible state.

tool_schemas.name: notify_price_change
tool_schemas.description: Checks the provided stock symbols for price moves and returns any symbols whose percentage change meets or exceeds the given threshold. It refuses requests with an empty stocks list, unknown/unpriced symbols, or a non-positive/invalid threshold. It may also refuse requests when market data is unavailable for the requested symbols at the time of the check.

stocks.description: List of stock symbols to check.

threshold.description: Percentage change threshold to trigger a notification.

tool_schemas.name: place_order
tool_schemas.description: Submits a buy or sell order for the given symbol, price, and share amount and returns the created order details as recorded by the service. It refuses requests when the user is not logged in, when order_type is not supported, when symbol is unknown or not tradable, when price is not positive, or when amount is not a positive integer. It also refuses orders that exceed available buying power for buys, exceed held shares for sells, or conflict with the account’s current trading state (e.g., restricted or inactive).

symbol.description: Symbol of the stock to trade.

price.description: Price at which to place the order.

tool_schemas.name: remove_stock_from_watchlist
tool_schemas.description: Removes the specified symbol from the logged-in user’s watchlist and returns the updated watchlist (or confirmation of removal). It refuses requests when the user is not logged in, when the symbol is missing/blank, or when the symbol is not present in the user’s watchlist. It also refuses attempts to modify a watchlist that is not owned by the current user/session.

symbol.description: Symbol of the stock to remove.

tool_schemas.name: trading_get_login_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current session’s authentication state (whether a user is logged in) and any available session identity context. It refuses requests when the session state cannot be read or has expired in a way that prevents determining status. It does not allow checking the status of any other user’s session.

tool_schemas.name: trading_login
tool_schemas.description: Authenticates a user with the provided credentials, establishes a trading session, and returns the resulting login/session status. It refuses requests with missing credentials, invalid username/password, or attempts to log in when an active session already exists and cannot be replaced. It may also refuse logins for locked/disabled accounts or when authentication services are unavailable.

tool_schemas.name: trading_logout
tool_schemas.description: Ends the current trading session and returns the resulting logout/session status. It refuses requests when there is no active logged-in session to terminate or when the session is already expired and cannot be cleanly logged out. It does not log out other users or sessions.

tool_schemas.name: update_market_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates the session’s market status (for example, open or closed) based on the provided current time string and returns the updated market status. Refuses requests where the time is missing, not in the required HH:MM AM/PM format, or cannot be interpreted as a valid time. Refuses updates that would be inconsistent with the service’s market-hours rules for that session (such as times outside supported trading hours).

current_time_str.description: Current time in HH:MM AM/PM format.

tool_schemas.name: update_stock_price
tool_schemas.description: Updates the current quote price for the specified stock symbol in the session’s market data and returns the updated stock information. Refuses requests where the symbol is missing/blank, does not match a known or tracked instrument in the service, or where the new price is missing or not a valid numeric value. Refuses prices that are not allowed by the data model (such as zero or negative values) or updates that conflict with the current session state (for example, attempting to update when the market data context is unavailable).

symbol.description: Symbol of the stock to update.

metadata.name: Keystone Trading Session Hub
metadata.description: A backend service that manages authenticated trading sessions by providing real-time stock data, order placement and cancellation, account funding and history, and watchlist monitoring with price-change notifications.
